known_limitations: Generic password/token content rule produces false positives on code (dashboard.py, bootstrap_ez_vlc_android.sh were blocked).
PII check is regex only: SSN-shaped, DOB and account/claim-number shapes. Names and addresses are not detected.
History check is by file NAME only and uses local history, which can differ from the public state after a local rewrite or unpushed commit.
Non-git activity labels use mtime, which a restore can reset.
Zero-byte extensionless files (Bootstrapping, Environment, FETCH_HEAD) are classed OTHER, not JUNK.
.wg_private_key is not in SECRET_NAMES; it is only kept out of the archive because dotfiles are CONFIG.
EXPECTED includes 'handover', which belongs to the Debian VM, so Termux always reports it missing.
Per-project scans are capped at 3000 files; the unauthenticated API allows about 60 calls per hour.

gsw_overhaul.source: git_superuser_workflow.sh version 2025.11.14_ENHANCED3; paste ends mid local_snapshot at a shasum line, so restore, hooks, --check and arg parsing were never reviewed.
bugs_reproduced_in_sandbox: G1 run_or_dry is bash -c with the joined args, so branch names execute: a merged branch named a$(touch${IFS}PWNED)b created the file PWNED.
G2 Branch cleanup regex '^[* ](main|master|develop|trunk)$' matches one prefix char but git branch prints two: master and develop were deleted and '* main' was passed to git branch -d.
G3 primary_branch returns 'origin' (not main) when origin/HEAD exists, git 2.43.
G4 Section 3 of the audit aborts on repos with no origin branches: set -e plus pipefail plus grep -v with empty output exits 1.
G5 mktemp_dir runs inside command substitution so WF_TMPDIR never reaches the parent: temp dirs are created in the repo cwd and never cleaned.
G6 safe_stat_size prints the size twice.
G7 _cmd always exits 0 so the shasum fallback is dead; shasum without -a 256 would be SHA-1.
G8 With core.hooksPath set, .git/hooks/pre-commit is ignored (commit succeeded despite a blocking hook).
inferred_not_reproduced: gitleaks runs without --redact, so raw secret values land in a report inside the repo cwd; the grep fallback prints matched lines and searches for the word key.
core.compression 0 grows repos on a near-full disk; gc --aggressive --prune=now is heavy on a phone.
dependency_master upgrades live trees; pip is PEP 668 blocked on the VM.
Snapshots exclude .git so they are not history backups; a snapshot of $HOME would recurse into ~/.local/snapshots.
Logs go to stdout so --json output is not clean; JSON is built with printf and sed; prune leaves orphan .sha256 files.
numfmt_or_human has an awk program with no BEGIN block.

guardrails: Never run git clean -fd, git reset --hard or rm -rf without a verified git bundle and checksum first.
Never git add -A or commit from a home directory.

Termux Python has no os.link; catch AttributeError as well as OSError.
Write reports and dumps outside repo directories, mode 0600.
